texts.SamplePageMessage: A sample page for the Intelligence module
texts.InventoryRulesSubtitle: Configure how the decision engine reacts to stock changes.
texts.ActionModeHint: Suggest Only waits for a human decision. Create Draft auto-creates the corrective draft document. Auto-Submit also submits it for approval — a human still approves it.
texts.ScopeSectionHint: Leave a field empty to apply the rule globally. Product + Branch can be combined for a specific match.
texts.SuggestedActionPlaceholder: e.g. Reorder from supplier / Transfer to Branch X / Discount 20%
texts.PriorityHelper: Higher number = evaluated first when multiple rules match
texts.DeleteRuleConfirmation: Are you sure you want to delete this rule? The engine will no longer evaluate it. Existing decision logs that reference this rule are kept as historical records and are not affected.
texts.Intelligence:Rules:ThresholdValueRequire: A stock quantity threshold is required for this rule type.
texts.Intelligence:Rules:ThresholdDaysRequired: A number of days is required for Dead Stock (days without sale) and Expiring Soon (days until expiry) rules.
texts.Intelligence:DecisionLogs:NotPending: This decision has already been resolved and cannot be changed.
texts.Intelligence:DecisionLogs:BranchRequired: This decision has no branch, so a purchase order cannot be created automatically.
texts.Intelligence:DecisionLogs:TransferBranch: This decision is missing its source or target branch, so a stock transfer cannot be created automatically.
texts.Intelligence:DecisionLogs:NoDefaultSuppl: The product has no default supplier, so a purchase order cannot be created automatically. Set a default supplier on the product first.
texts.Intelligence:DecisionLogs:OutcomeAlready: This decision's outcome has already been recorded and cannot be changed.
texts.Intelligence:DecisionLogs:WriteOffBranch: This decision has no branch, so a stock write-off cannot be recorded.
texts.Intelligence:DecisionLogs:WriteOffNoInve: The product is not initialized at this branch, so a stock write-off cannot be recorded.
texts.Effectiveness:Hint:Noisy: Noisy: 70%+ of alerts dismissed — consider relaxing the threshold.
texts.Effectiveness:Hint:DismissedStockouts: Warning: dismissed alerts were followed by stockouts — alerts were warranted.
texts.Permission:DecisionLogs.Acknowledge: Acknowledge, dismiss, or mark decisions executed
texts.DecisionLogSubtitle: Every recommendation the engine has made, and why.
texts.DecisionLog:EmptyPending: Nothing needs your attention — all clear.
texts.DecisionLog:Empty: No decisions match the current filters.
texts.DecisionLog:ExecutePreview:Title: Review action
texts.DecisionLog:ExecutePreview:POIntro: This will create a draft purchase order. Nothing is sent to the supplier until a user approves it.
texts.DecisionLog:ExecutePreview:TransferIntro: This will create a draft stock transfer. The transfer still needs the normal submit and confirmation steps.
texts.DecisionLog:ExecutePreview:WriteOffIntro: This will immediately record a stock write-off for the expired quantity.
texts.DecisionLog:ExecutePreview:TransferReque: This will open the stock transfer request form with the decision context. The request is not saved until you finish the form.
texts.DecisionLog:ExecutePreview:ProductionReq: This will open the product request form with this decision filled in. The request is not saved until you press Save there.
texts.DecisionLog:ExecutePreview:NoDocumentInt: This decision has no generated document. Continuing will mark it as executed only.
texts.DecisionLog:ExecutePreview:GenericIntro: Review the suggested action before continuing.
texts.StockReportNote: Created from a cashier stock report.
texts.DecisionReasoning:ExpiryAlert: “{0}” at {1} needs attention before it expires: batch {3} has {2} unit(s) and {4}. This is inside your {5}-day early-warning window.
texts.DecisionReasoning:ExpiryAlert:Total: In total, {0} unit(s) across {1} batch(es) are close to expiring.
texts.DecisionReasoning:ExpiryAlert:ActionHint: Suggested action: check the shelf, then decide — sell at a discount, move it to a faster-selling branch, or write it off if it can no longer be sold.
texts.DecisionReasoning:WasteWriteOff: “{0}” at {1} is no longer sellable: {2} expired unit(s) across {3} batch(es). The oldest batch is {4} — {5}. Estimated loss: {6} ({7} units × {8} unit cost). These units should be written off the stock.
texts.DecisionReasoning:LowStock: Only {0} unit(s) left — below the minimum of {1}. Time to reorder.
texts.DecisionReasoning:ExcessStock: {0} unit(s) on hand — more than the ceiling of {1}. Consider moving or discounting the extra before it goes to waste.
texts.DecisionReasoning:StockoutRisk: Only {0} unit(s) left. At the expected sales pace that is about {1} day(s) of stock — inside the {2}-day safety window. Reorder now.
texts.DecisionReasoning:StockoutRisk:Flat: Only {0} unit(s) left — about {1} day(s) of stock at the average sales pace, inside the {2}-day safety window. Reorder now.
texts.DecisionReasoning:StockoutRisk:WithProdu: “{0}” at {1} has only {2} unit(s) left. It could run out in about {3} day(s) — inside the {4}-day safety window. Suggested action: reorder now.
texts.DecisionReasoning:StockoutRisk:FlatWithP: “{0}” at {1} has only {2} unit(s) left — about {3} day(s) of stock at the average sales pace, inside the {4}-day safety window. Suggested action: reorder now.
texts.DecisionReasoning:DeadStock: “{0}” at {1} has not sold for {2} day(s) — longer than the {3}-day limit. Suggested action: check demand, then discount it, move it to another branch, or stop restocking it.
texts.DecisionReasoning:TransferSuggestion: “{0}” is running low at {1}: {2} unit(s) on hand, below the minimum of {3}. {4} has {5} spare unit(s). Suggested action: transfer stock from the branch with the surplus.
texts.DecisionLog:Consolidate:Title: Consolidate reorders
texts.DecisionLog:Consolidate:Confirm: Create draft purchase orders from the pending reorder alerts, grouped by supplier and branch?
texts.DecisionLog:Consolidate:Result: Created {0} draft purchase order(s) from {1} alert(s)
texts.DecisionLog:Consolidate:Nothing: No pending reorder alerts to consolidate.
texts.ReorderCalendar:Subtitle: What's coming up: predicted stockouts, batches expiring, and expected deliveries.
texts.ReorderCalendar:UpcomingSub: Chronological list of what's coming up.
texts.ReorderCalendar:Empty: Nothing scheduled in the next two weeks.
texts.ReorderCalendar:Truncated: Some events were hidden — narrow the branch filter to see all.
texts.ProductVelocitySubtitle: Nightly-computed sales velocity, ABC class, weekday-indexed 7-day forecast and days of cover per product and branch.
texts.ProductVelocity:Filter: Search by product name or SKU
texts.ProductVelocity:Empty: No velocity data yet. The nightly scan computes it from recorded sales.
